item.title: [MEDIUM] GHSA: OpenTelemetry Java Instrumentation: JDBC Auto-Instrumentation Logging Clear-Text Passwords
item.description: OpenTelemetry Java Instrumentation JDBC auto-instrumentation may fail to sanitize passwords in SQL CONNECT statements when the password is double-quoted. As a result, clear-text database passwords can be added to trace span attributes and exported to observability backends.

item.title: [MEDIUM] GHSA: netfoil: Incorrect block responses could lead to localhost traffic
item.description: ### Summary `0.0.0.0` was used instead of NXDOMAIN for block responses. On Linux, which is the target platform for netfoil, the `0.0.0.0` is sent to localhost rather than just dropped. ### Impact Unintended traffic could be sent to localhost. Impact depends on running services and firewall rules.
